scope: Retrospective agreement on eight confidently transcribed reference cases; not overall accuracy or recall.
normalization: Upper case; remove whitespace and ASCII hyphens only; no character correction.
excluded: Four uncertain strings and all entries lacking an explicit confident plate reference.
matching: Assistant-assisted source-frame/appearance/position audit, stored separately; not selected by string equality.
limitations: The 21 worksheet rows are descriptions, not 21 independently established passages. At least two vehicles appear in both early side-view and later rear-view rows.
All eight confidently transcribed plate cases enter the primary comparison, including the German plate; four uncertain strings do not.

A case is covered if at least one linked lifetime string equals the human reference after separator-only normalization. Multiple outputs count once for this coverage, and discordant extra outputs remain visible.
This conditional, retrospective coverage is not overall traffic accuracy, output precision, physical recall, independently held-out performance, or proof of correct production event association.

Winning candidate plate boxes locate output evidence on the source vehicle; last-known vehicle boxes can refer to a different time. Full per-frame trajectories and purity of every observation history were not validated.
No character read from model output or assistant inspection replaces a human worksheet character. Foreign text is not forced into Hungarian syntax.
The two humans reviewed jointly; no inter-rater agreement statistic or blinded annotation is claimed.
